hero.headline: Journey Toward God.
hero.description: Homeward is a spiritual community for people longing for deeper faith, authentic friendship, and time-tested practices—like Christian meditation, contemplative prayer, and silent presence—that help us experience God more deeply and carry that life into the world through love.

rooted_line: Rooted in the life and way of Jesus, Homeward is open to all who genuinely seek God in love. We welcome faith, questions, hope, doubt, and uncertainty.

recognition.heading: Does any of this feel familiar?
recognition.intro: Homeward began with questions many people carry quietly—and the hope that faith can still become deeper, more honest, and more alive.
questions: You still feel drawn to God—or to the life and way of Jesus—but carry questions or doubts you have never been able to resolve?
You long for a deeper experience of God—not just more religious information?
You want spiritual practices that help you become calmer, more present, and more loving?
You are looking for a community that welcomes questions without demanding easy answers?
You want meaningful friendships where you can speak honestly about faith and life?
You believe faith should change how we live, relate, and care for the world?
recognition.honest_line: Wherever you are in your understanding of God, you are welcome to begin honestly.

circles.badge: Registration is open for upcoming Circles.
circles.description: Homeward Circles are eight-week guided experiences for 6–8 people who want deeper faith, real friendship, and room for honest questions. Each gathering combines coffee or a shared meal, Christian meditation, thoughtful teaching inspired by Jesus, and conversation that connects it all to everyday life. No expertise, polished answers, or prior meditation experience is required.
circles.quote: A Circle is a place to become present, known, and formed together—one honest gathering at a time.

steps.title: Become present
steps.description: A brief meditation, prayer, or spiritual practice.

steps.title: Explore
steps.description: Scripture and thoughtful teaching inspired by Jesus.

steps.title: Share
steps.description: Honest conversation without pressure for the right answer.

steps.title: Carry it home
steps.description: A simple practice or invitation for the week.

values.heading:
A place to belong.
A way to become.
values.intro: A community where spiritual depth and honest friendship grow together—without requiring certainty, performance, or pretending.

items.title: Belong
items.description: Wherever you are in your understanding of God, you are welcome to begin honestly—with your faith, questions, hope, and uncertainty.

items.title: Grow
items.description: Christian meditation, contemplative prayer, and silent presence help us become more attentive to God, ourselves, and one another.

items.title: Become
items.description: Spiritual formation becomes a lived way of being—more present, compassionate, courageous, and loving in the world.

practices.heading: Simple practices for everyday life.
practices.intro: Homeward practices are simple ways of slowing down, paying attention, and opening our lives to God. No prior experience is needed, and there is nothing to perform or master.

items.title: Light of Christ
items.description: A guided meditation in which we receive the loving light of Christ, rest in that presence, and allow the light to radiate toward those we love, the wider world, and all creation.

items.title: Breath Prayer
items.description: A simple prayer joined to the natural rhythm of breathing—such as, “Breathing in, I receive peace. Breathing out, I offer love.”

items.title: Maranatha Prayer
items.description: Silently repeating Maranatha—Come, Lord Jesus as a way of gathering the mind, releasing distraction, and welcoming the presence of God.

items.title: Inspired Reading
items.description: A time-honored method and practice for reading Scripture and listening for the words, images, or invitations that speak to your life.

items.title: Daily Reflection
items.subtitle: Noticing God in your day
items.description: A five-step process for reviewing your day with gratitude and honesty, noticing where you felt alive, distant, loved, or invited to grow.

items.title: Prayer of Gratitude
items.description: A gentle practice of remembering the gifts, people, and moments that have sustained us—and allowing gratitude to widen our awareness of God’s goodness.

journey.heading: Faith grows through seasons—and questions can deepen it.
journey.description: Faith rarely develops in a straight line. We inherit beliefs, encounter questions, search, rebuild, embody, and awaken—often revisiting each season with greater honesty and depth. Questions do not have to weaken faith; they can lead us toward a faith that is more resilient, alive, and truly our own.

stages.title: Honest Questions
stages.description: Questions and doubt open the journey.

stages.title: New Foundations
stages.description: Faith becomes deeper and your own.

stages.title: Embodied Faith
stages.description: Belief becomes a way of living.

journey.benefit_heading: A reflection that gives you something useful.
journey.benefit_text: In about five minutes, you will receive a personal stage reflection with books, videos, practices, and insights selected to support your next step. There are no scores, labels, or right answers.

remembering.heading: We gather
remembering.intro1: Homeward began because many people longed for more—more presence, more meaning, and a community where love for God, a connection to the life and teachings of Jesus, and honest questions could live together.
remembering.intro2: We come together to help one another remember what matters most.
items: Remembering that we do not have to make the journey alone.
remembering.why_text: Remembering helps us return to God more deeply and more often. As we return, we become more open to the joy, love, compassion, peace, awe, and wonder that make life truly come alive.
remembering.footer_text: Maybe you have been looking for your people, too.

interest.heading: Tell us what interests you.
interest.description: You do not have to schedule anything yet. Share what is drawing you toward Homeward, and someone from the community will follow up personally.
interest.calendar_text: Open the conversation calendar directly—or choose “I’d like to talk about Homeward or a Circle” in the form and the calendar will open after your information is received.

final.heading: Begin in the way that feels honest.
final.description: Reflect privately, experience a practice, explore a Circle, tell us you are interested, or have a short conversation about Homeward.
